target_moa.text: Dabrafenib is an inhibitor of some mutated forms of BRAF kinases (including BRAF V600E, V600K, V600D); constitutively activated mutant BRAF kinases stimulate tumor cell growth, and dabrafenib inhibits BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma cell growth.

citations.quote: Dabrafenib is an inhibitor of some mutated forms of BRAF kinases with in vitro IC_{50} values of 0.65, 0.5, and 1.84 nM for BRAF V600E, BRAF V600K, and BRAF V600D enzymes, respectively. Dabrafenib also inhibits wild-type BRAF and CRAF kinases with IC_{50} values of 3.2 and 5.0 nM, respectively, and other kinases such as SIK1, NEK11, and LIMK1 at higher concentrations. Some mutations in the BRAF gene, including those that result in BRAF V600E, can result in constitutively activated BRAF kinases that may stimulate tumor cell growth [see *Indications and Usage (1)*]. Dabrafenib inhibits BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma cell growth in vitro and in vivo.
